description.en: Everything from the cockpit to the inside of the laser cannon has been faithfully reproduced without any compromise.

description.ja: ●　劇中再現への拘り　－　Obsession with Accurately Recreating the Millennium Falcon from the Movie　－
description.en: ● Obsession with Accurately Recreating the Millennium Falcon from the Movie -

description.ja: ２度にわたる現地取材、撮影用モデル研究家の鷲見氏・高橋氏の全面協力により、
description.en: Thanks to two on-site interviews and the full cooperation of photography model researchers Mr. Sumi and Mr. Takahashi,

description.ja: 「1.7mの撮影用モデル」を徹底的に研究。
description.en: Thoroughly researched the "1.7m photography model".

description.ja: 撮影モデルの情報量をすべて再現する、1/72 scale 全長482mmの大型サイズで、撮影用モデルを徹底再現。
description.en: A large size of 1/72 scale with a total length of 482mm, which reproduces all the information of the shooting model, thoroughly reproduces the shooting model.

description.ja: ●　高次ディテールの再現　－　Reproducing the Finest Details　－
description.en: ● Reproducing the Finest Details -

description.ja: 外装はもちろん、内部ディテール構造まで徹底的に作りこみ。
description.en: Not only the exterior but also the internal detail structure has been thoroughly elaborated.

description.ja: ・コクピット
description.en: ·cockpit

description.ja: シートやコンソール部分のパネル、壁面の計器類に至るまで、形状を再現。
description.en: The shapes of the seats, console panels, and wall instruments have been recreated.

description.ja: 組みあげることで、「ミレニアム・ファルコン」を操縦することへの構造的な理解が深まる。
description.en: By putting it together, you will deepen your structural understanding of operating the Millennium Falcon.

description.ja: ・レーザー砲
description.en: ・Laser cannon

description.ja: 砲手のシートやレーザー砲のトリガーなどを内部に作り込み。
description.en: The gunner's seat and laser cannon trigger are built inside.

description.ja: そのうえで、精密に再現された4連装レーザー砲が被さる。
description.en: On top of that is a precisely reproduced quadruple laser cannon.

description.ja: 戦闘時の砲手とレーザー砲の距離感なども体感できる。
description.en: You can also experience the distance between the gunner and the laser cannon during battle.

description.ja: ・機首
description.en: ·nose

description.ja: 穴壁面
description.en: hole wall

description.ja: 穴内部の構造物はもちろんのこと、円筒形の穴の側面の種々の構造物までも余すところなく再現。
description.en: Not only the structures inside the hole, but also the various structures on the sides of the cylindrical hole are thoroughly reproduced.

description.ja: サイドディティール
description.en: side detail

description.ja: サイドのディテールの密集部も、効果的にパーツ分割することで立体的な表現を追求。
description.en: Even the areas with dense details on the sides are effectively divided into parts to create a three-dimensional expression.

description.ja: 縦横無尽に走る管も独立したパーツと併用することで、より撮影用モデルに近い形状を実現。
description.en: By using the tubes that run in all directions in combination with independent parts, we have achieved a shape that is closer to that of a photography model.

description.ja: 中央ディテール
description.en: central detail

description.ja: 非常に入り組んでいる中央部も、「1.7mの撮影用モデル」の取材・研究で、正確な形状を把握。
description.en: Even the very intricate central part was able to ascertain its exact shape through research and research using a 1.7m photographic model.

description.ja: 複雑な構造を忠実に再現。
description.en: Faithfully reproduces complex structures.

description.ja: ・機体後部　／　ダクト周辺
description.en: ・Aft part of the aircraft / around the duct

description.ja: ミレニアム・ファルコン上面の特徴的なディテール密集部を詳細に作り込んでいる。
description.en: The characteristic densely detailed parts of the top of the Millennium Falcon are detailed.

description.ja: ダクトの網部分はプラスチックパーツとエッチングパーツの選択式で、より細かな再現を追求。
description.en: The mesh part of the duct is a selection of plastic parts and photo-etched parts, pursuing even more detailed reproduction.

description.ja: ●　発光ギミック　―LED Light-Up Feature―
description.en: ● Light-emitting gimmick ―LED Light-Up Feature―

description.ja: 劇中の印象を補完する、光の演出。
description.en: A light production that complements the impression of the play.

description.ja: 光に照らし出されたその姿は、今まさに飛び立とうとしているかのごとき錯覚を与える。
description.en: Its appearance illuminated by light gives the illusion that it is about to take off.

description.ja: ・亜高速エンジン
description.en: ・Sub-high speed engine

description.ja: 「PG 1/72 ミレニアム・ファルコン」では、第一作をリスペクトして敢えて白色LEDで再現。
description.en: "PG 1/72 Millennium Falcon" respects the first work and dares to reproduce it with white LED.

description.ja: 特徴的な帯状のエンジン部は導光パーツを用いることで劇中のような発光を再現。
description.en: The characteristic belt-shaped engine part uses light guide parts to reproduce the light emission like in the movie.

description.ja: ・ランディングギア・昇降口
description.en: ・Landing gear・Gateway

description.ja: 特徴的な3本脚がLEDに照らされ、劇中さながらの力強さで機体を支える。
description.en: Its three distinctive legs are illuminated by LEDs and support the aircraft with the same strength as in the movie.

description.ja: 本箇所が発光することで駐機状態も再現可能。
description.en: By emitting light from this part, it is possible to recreate the parking situation.

description.ja: 昇降口は中まで緻密なモールドが彫り込まれており、
description.en: The entrance has a detailed mold carved into it,

description.ja: 今にもそこからハン・ソロが降りてきそうな雰囲気を醸し出す。
description.en: It creates an atmosphere that looks like Han Solo will descend from there at any moment.

description.ja: ・コクピット
description.en: ·cockpit

description.ja: 劇中のコクピット同様に特徴ある後方パネルが発光し、劇中のシーンを思い起こさせる。
description.en: Like the cockpit in the movie, the distinctive rear panel lights up, reminding you of scenes in the movie.
